hypothesis: Very short-term oversold shocks in broad equity indices mean-revert while the long-term trend remains positive.

rule.entry: RSI(2) Wilder below 5 and close above SMA(200), fill next open
rule.exit: close above SMA(5), fill next open, or maximum 10 sessions
rule.sizing: whole shares from USD/EUR 1000 sleeve; currency treated one-for-one only for mechanism screening

prohibitions: No promotion without provider and SQ parity
